landing.eyebrow: Problem statement 26092 · Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
landing.headline: Find the support that fits
landing.sub: Answer a few questions. A published rule decides what you qualify for, tells you why, and names the office near you that can actually process it.
landing.ctaSignIn: Sign in or create an account
landing.step1Body: Category, income, what the money is for, where you live.
landing.step2Body: The same published criteria every time. No model votes on your eligibility.
landing.step3Body: Each scheme lists what you met, what blocked you, and the rule behind it.
landing.step4Body: Only partners authorised for that scheme and taking new applications.
landing.statsTitle: What is in the system today
landing.footerBody: Checking costs nothing and stores nothing. An account only saves your answers so you do not type them twice.
landing.notOfficial: A Smart India Hackathon 2026 prototype. Not an official government portal.
